title_en: Lu Zhengming v. Shanghai Engineering Complete Set General Company and Wude City Environmental Sanitation Engineering Experimental Factory — patent infringement appeal

full_text_en:
Lu Zhengming v. Shanghai Engineering Complete Set Company and Wuxi Environmental Sanitation Engineering Experimental Plant — Patent Infringement Appeal

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): Lu Zhengming, male, 49 years old, engineer at Shanghai Municipal Waste Disposal Management Office.

Appellee (Defendant at First Instance): Shanghai Engineering Complete Set Company (formerly Shanghai Economic Zone Environmental Protection and Energy-Saving Engineering Complete Set Company).
Legal Representative: Ren Qiaojin, General Manager.

Appellee (Defendant at First Instance): Wuxi Environmental Sanitation Engineering Experimental Plant (formerly Wuxi Waste Treatment Experimental Plant).
Legal Representative: Wang Weibang, Plant Director.

Appellant Lu Zhengming, dissatisfied with the civil judgment (91) Hu Zhong Jing Zi No. 8 rendered by the Shanghai Intermediate People's Court in a patent infringement case, filed an appeal with the Shanghai High People's Court.

The court of first instance found that Lu Zhengming obtained the utility model patent for "Aged Garbage Combined Screen Crusher" (Patent No. 87207485.4) on March 28, 1989. After Wuxi Environmental Sanitation Engineering Experimental Plant (hereinafter "Environmental Sanitation Plant") undertook the research task of "Development and Research on Harmless Treatment Technology of Urban Domestic Garbage in Wuxi City" under the *1985 National Urban and Rural Construction Science and Technology Development Plan* of the Ministry of Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection, it commissioned Shanghai Engineering Complete Set Company (hereinafter "Complete Set Company") in April 1989 to develop a screening and crushing machine. The Shanghai Science and Technology Consulting Service Center, entrusted by the court of first instance, organized experts to conduct a technical appraisal of the "Screening and Crushing Machine" developed by Complete Set Company and concluded that the equipment was equivalent to the technical solution claimed in Lu Zhengming's patent claims.

The court of first instance held that Environmental Sanitation Plant commissioned Complete Set Company to develop the screening and crushing machine in order to complete the scientific research project assigned by the Ministry of Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection, and that this constituted using the relevant patent solely for the purposes of scientific research and experimentation, and should not be deemed as infringement of Lu Zhengming's patent right. The court of first instance, in accordance with Article 62, Item 5 of the *Patent Law of the People's Republic of China*, ruled that Lu Zhengming's claims were not supported, and ordered Lu Zhengming to bear the first-instance litigation costs of RMB 3,010.

Lu Zhengming appealed, arguing that after the facts of infringement were established, the lower court erred in applying the law; that Complete Set Company, after Lu Zhengming obtained the patent, manufactured the screening and crushing machine without the patentee's permission, constituting infringement; and that Environmental Sanitation Plant used the screening and crushing machine in garbage disposal production, also constituting infringement. He therefore requested that the original judgment be reversed, that Complete Set Company and Environmental Sanitation Plant be ordered to cease manufacturing, using, and selling the patented product; that Complete Set Company compensate the appellant for economic losses of RMB 50,000; and that Complete Set Company and Environmental Sanitation Plant bear the litigation costs of both the first and second instances.

Upon trial, the Shanghai High People's Court found that after Environmental Sanitation Plant undertook the project "Development and Research on Harmless Treatment Technology of Urban Domestic Garbage in Wuxi City" under the *1985 National Urban and Rural Construction Science and Technology Development Plan* of the Ministry of Urban and Rural Construction and Environmental Protection (hereinafter "Ministry of Construction"), it signed an agreement with Complete Set Company on April 8, 1989, stipulating that Complete Set Company would provide complete technical services for the design, manufacture, installation, and commissioning of the key equipment in the post-treatment workshop — the screening and crushing machine — at a cost of RMB 130,000. On the same day, Complete Set Company also signed an agreement with Dongtai Environmental Machinery Equipment Factory, stipulating that Dongtai Environmental Machinery Equipment Factory would undertake the processing, manufacturing, transportation, on-site installation, commissioning, and after-sales service of the screening and crushing machine according to the design drawings and requirements provided by Complete Set Company, at a cost of RMB 107,800.

Environmental Sanitation Plant began using the screening and crushing machine provided by Complete Set Company in August 1989 and had paid RMB 110,000. On June 6, 1990, the Ministry of Construction, the National Patriotic Health Campaign Committee Office, and the Jiangsu Provincial Construction Committee organized an appraisal of the project "Development and Research on Harmless Treatment Technology of Urban Domestic Garbage in Wuxi City" undertaken by Environmental Sanitation Plant and the Department of Environmental Engineering of Tongji University. The appraisal opinion stated that the research results met the project requirements and recommended further improvement and matching of process facilities and equipment such as metering and incineration.

During the hearing, the Shanghai High People's Court inspected the screening and crushing machine. Environmental Sanitation Plant was still using the machine, but the original crushing device and hole-clearing device had been removed during the first-instance proceedings. According to statistical data provided by Environmental Sanitation Plant, the plant processed over 7,000 tons of garbage in 1992, with an average selling price of RMB 4.59 per ton, and transportation costs for selling the garbage exceeded RMB 200,000.

The Shanghai High People's Court held that the lower court correctly found that the screening and crushing machine developed by Complete Set Company was equivalent to the technical solution protected by Lu Zhengming's utility model patent for "Aged Garbage Combined Screen Crusher." The provision in Article 62, Item 5 of the *Patent Law of the People's Republic of China* that "the use of a relevant patent solely for the purposes of scientific research and experimentation" "shall not be deemed as infringement of the patent right" refers to the demonstrative use of the relevant patent under laboratory conditions to explore and research new inventions based on existing patent technology, or to examine and verify the technical and economic effects of the relevant patent. According to the agreement signed between Environmental Sanitation Plant and Complete Set Company, Complete Set Company directly used Lu Zhengming's patented technology to design and manufacture mechanical equipment for the completion of the design, manufacture, installation, and commissioning of the screening and crushing machine in the post-treatment workshop of Environmental Sanitation Plant, and then sold the equipment to Environmental Sanitation Plant for use. Such conduct cannot be considered a legitimate act of using the patent solely for scientific research and experimentation, and therefore constitutes an infringement of Lu Zhengming's patent right, for which Complete Set Company should bear civil liability. After the scientific research project had passed appraisal, Environmental Sanitation Plant no longer had a scientific research task for the garbage screening and crushing machine. Its use of the infringing product manufactured and sold by Complete Set Company for garbage disposal, coupled with certain sales activities, constituted a use for production and business purposes, which also did not meet the conditions of "solely for scientific research and experimentation." Therefore, infringement should be found. Accordingly, the facts found by the lower court were basically correct, but the application of law was erroneous, and the judgment should be reversed. The economic losses caused to Lu Zhengming should be calculated based on a reasonable amount not less than the reasonable patent licensing fee. Pursuant to Article 153, Paragraph 1, Item 2 and Article 158 of the *Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China*, and Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the *Patent Law of the People's Republic of China*, the judgment is as follows:

1. The civil judgment (91) Hu Zhong Jing Zi No. 8 of the Shanghai Intermediate People's Court is reversed;
2. Shanghai Engineering Complete Set Company shall compensate Lu Zhengming for economic losses in the amount of RMB 20,000;
3. The appraisal fee of RMB 1,000 shall be borne equally by Shanghai Engineering Complete Set Company (RMB 500) and Wuxi Environmental Sanitation Engineering Experimental Plant (RMB 500).
